# CityNews Toronto

> > CityNews Toronto is a Rogers-owned local news station delivering breaking news, politics, weather, traffic, and community stories across Toronto, the GTA, and Ontario.

CityNews Toronto provides comprehensive coverage of local and national news through video, audio, and written content. The station features live radio broadcasts with hosts like Rob Snow, covering topics from municipal politics and the Doug Ford government to real estate, health, and community advocacy through programs like Speakers Corner.

## Key Topics

- Toronto local news
- GTA coverage
- Doug Ford and Ontario politics
- Canadian politics and government
- Live radio broadcasts
- Audio content and podcasts
- Community stories and advocacy
- Real estate and housing market
- Traffic and weather updates
- Health and public safety
- Speakers Corner consumer advocacy
- National video archive
- Calgary and western Canada coverage
- Rob Snow radio programs
- Rogers Media network

## Core News Coverage

- [Breaking News - Top Local Stories](https://toronto.citynews.ca): CityNews Toronto homepage with breaking news, traffic, weather, and local stories
- [Politics](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/politics): Ontario and Canadian politics coverage featuring Doug Ford government
- [Health](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/health): Health news covering public health, harm reduction, and medical insights
- [Real Estate](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/real-estate): Toronto and GTA real estate market trends, home sales, and housing news
- [Canada National Video](https://toronto.citynews.ca/video/national-video): National video archive covering Canada news, politics, and weather

## Community and Local Stories

- [Your Community](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/your-community): Local community stories, social issues, and neighborhood news
- [Speakers Corner](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/speakers-corner): Community stories and consumer advocacy from Speakers Corner
- [From Our Reporters](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/from-our-reporters): Reporter-filed news articles covering local and national stories

## Live Radio and Audio Content

- [The World on CityNews](https://toronto.citynews.ca/audio/the-world-on-citynews): Live radio broadcasts and podcasts covering world news
- [Latest Sports Update](https://toronto.citynews.ca/audio/latest-sports-update): Audio sports updates and live radio broadcasts with Rob Snow
- [NewsRadio Bookshelf](https://toronto.citynews.ca/audio/citynews-bookshelf): Audio content and radio show featuring Rob Snow's NewsRadio Bookshelf
- [Latest Cottage Country Traffic](https://toronto.citynews.ca/audio/latest-cottage-country-traffic): Audio traffic reports for Cottage Country with Rob Snow

## Regional Coverage

- [Calgary Election 2025](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/calgary-election-2025): Calgary municipal election 2025 coverage and updates
- [Calgary Stampede](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/calgary-stampede): Calgary Stampede event coverage and related news stories
- [Halifax Mooseheads](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/halifax-mooseheads-hockey): Halifax Mooseheads hockey team news and sports coverage

## Optional

- [Showcase](https://toronto.citynews.ca/topic/showcase): Sponsored and branded partner content showcase
- [Professional Insights - Laser Health Solutions](https://toronto.citynews.ca/audio/professional-insights-laser-health-solutions): Sponsored audio segment featuring Laser Health Solutions insights
